title: PostgreSQL data integrity
description: Checks for transaction boundaries, schema changes and queries that serve important paths.

rules.instruction: Use database constraints for invariants the schema can express. Put writes that must succeed together in one transaction.
rules.verification: Run an integration case that fails partway through the operation and check that the prior committed state is intact. Verify the relevant constraint with an invalid fixture.

rules.instruction: Check existing rows and supported readers and writers before tightening constraints or removing fields. Sequence the migration and record its recovery plan.
rules.verification: Apply the migration to representative data on the supported PostgreSQL version. Verify fresh setup, upgrade from the prior schema and coexistence of app versions if the rollout requires it.

rules.instruction: Measure changed critical queries with data volumes and distributions that represent the expected workload. Record any index or query changes that follow.
rules.verification: Review the query plan and measured timings on approved test data. Use execution-based plan collection only where running the statement is permitted.
